subject: english
question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

Certain to happen
solution: The correct answer is: **Inevitable** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **Inevitable **means something that is certain to happen. (कुछ ऐसा जो घटित होना निश्चित है) • **For example-** *It was inevitable that the company would go bankrupt.* • It is an adjective that can be used to describe a situation or event. • **Synonyms**: *unavoidable, certain, unavoidable, inescapable.* Therefore, **option 4** is the correct answer. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Justifiable **means something that is reasonable or can be defended with logic or evidence. (कुछ ऐसा जो उचित हो या जिसका तर्क या साक्ष्य से बचाव किया जा सके) • **Indispensable **means something that is absolutely necessary and cannot be done without. (कुछ ऐसा जो नितांत आवश्यक है और उसके बिना नहीं किया जा सकता) • **Convertible **means something that can be changed or transformed into something else. (कुछ ऐसा जिसे बदला जा सकता है या किसी और चीज़ में बदला जा सकता है) 30:T6ff, The incorrectly spelt word is: **Nefew**
